CustomField.description: The controlled document whose primary file is the report template. Enter its Document Number (for example PHR-TEMPLATE-001) or its record Id. Leave blank to use PHR-TEMPLATE-001. If the document is not found or not Current, the built-in template is used.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Document Number or record Id of the controlled document that holds the report template. Blank = PHR-TEMPLATE-001. The document must be Current and have a Salesforce file as its primary content.
CustomField.label: Template Controlled Document
